raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #44789.

`MiMoProcessor` normalizes images with hard-coded OpenAI-CLIP mean/std. MiMo-V2.6 checkpoints now specify ImageNet stats in `preprocessor_config.json`, so SGLang normalizes V2.6 images differently from HF `Qwen2VLImageProcessor` with the same checkpoint, by up to 0.4941 per channel in the reproduction below.

The CLIP constant matched MiMo-V2.6 when #40888 was merged. The checkpoint config later changed to ImageNet stats in Xiaomi's [`6a7f202e`](https://huggingface.co/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD/commit/6a7f202e) ("Align preprocessor config to training values").

Different MiMo-V2 checkpoints now specify different stats:

| Checkpoint (`MiMoV2ForCausalLM`) | Normalization |
|---|---|
| MiMo-V2.6-Pro/Flash, -RL, -MOPD | ImageNet |
| MiMo-V2.5, MiMo-V2.5-Base | CLIP |
| MiMo-V2.5-Pro, -Pro-FP4-DFlash | text-only; multimodal disabled |

So no single hard-coded normalization is correct for all of them.

## Modifications

- `processors/mimo_v2.py`
  - Read `image_mean`/`image_std` from the loaded image processor, with the existing CLIP values as fallback.
  - Key the normalization cache by `(device, mean, std)` instead of only the device, so processors with different stats do not share cached tensors.
- `models/mimo_v2.py`, `disaggregation/encoder/preprocessor.py`
  - Pass the encode server's already-loaded `image_processor` to the MiMo hook through the existing `invoke_encoder_preprocessor` mechanism. The image call already used it; the video and audio calls now do too, so whichever modality arrives first builds the processor with the checkpoint's stats.
  - Log a warning when no image processor is loaded and the encoder falls back to CLIP.
- `test_mimo_v2_image_normalization.py`
  - Regression coverage for CLIP and ImageNet checkpoints sharing one device.
  - Encode-server coverage with a video request arriving first.

Pixel bounds are unchanged: SGLang reads them from `config.json`'s `processor_config`, which already has 8192/8388608 for V2.6. The FA4 vision sliding-window issue mentioned in #44789 (#38871) is separate.

## Accuracy Tests

Compared against HF `Qwen2VLImageProcessor` loaded from each checkpoint's own preprocessor config, with GPU preprocessing (`SGLANG_ENCODER_IMAGE_PROCESSOR_USE_GPU=1`) on both the regular and encode-server paths.

Setup: RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (sm89), PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, Transformers 5.19.0.

| Checkpoint | Path | main | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| MiMo-V2.5 (CLIP) | regular | match | match |
| MiMo-V2.5 (CLIP) | encode server | match | match |
| MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD (ImageNet) | regular | max diff 0.4941 | match |
| MiMo-V2.6-Pro-MOPD (ImageNet) | encode server | max diff 0.4941 | match |

With this PR, the normalization cache holds separate `cuda:0` entries for the CLIP and ImageNet stats.

Unit tests (the new test plus `test_encode_server.py`, `test_kimi_k3_encoder_mode.py`, `test_processor_async_call_sites.py`):
- main: the new ImageNet cases fail, with greatest absolute difference up to 0.4941.
- This PR: 115 passed, 0 failed, with and without `SGLANG_ENCODER_IMAGE_PROCESSOR_USE_GPU=1`.

I did not run a full MiMo-V2.6 serving comparison; the change is isolated to preprocessing and is checked directly against the HF processor.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. Normalization does the same arithmetic as before; the tensors are still cached per device, with the stats added to the cache key.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (Not applicable.)
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (Accuracy only; speed not applicable.)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+"""MiMo-V2 images are normalized with the checkpoint's image_mean/image_std, as HF does."""
+
+import asyncio
+import types
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+from PIL import Image
+from transformers import Qwen2VLImageProcessor
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.encoder.preprocessor import EncoderPreprocessor
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.models.mimo_v2 import MiMoV2ForCausalLM
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.processors.base_processor import BaseMultimodalProcessor
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.processors.mimo_v2 import (
+    ImageInput,
+    MiMoProcessor,
+    MiMoV2Processor,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=15, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+# Stats from XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-* and MiMo-V2.5 preprocessor_config.json.
+IMAGENET = dict(image_mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], image_std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
+CLIP = dict(
+    image_mean=[0.48145466, 0.4578275, 0.40821073],
+    image_std=[0.26862954, 0.26130258, 0.27577711],
+)
+
+# Subset of a MiMo-V2.6 config.json processor_config the constructor requires.
+_PROCESSOR_CONFIG = dict(
+    vision_start_token_id=1,
+    vision_end_token_id=2,
+    image_token_id=3,
+    video_token_id=4,
+    audio_token_id=5,
+    audio_start_token_id=6,
+    audio_end_token_id=7,
+    video_start_token_id=8,
+    video_end_token_id=9,
+    audio_sampling_rate=24000,
+    image_min_pixels=8192,
+    image_max_pixels=8388608,
+    use_video_timestamps=True,
+)
+
+COLORS = [(255, 0, 0), (128, 128, 128), (255, 255, 255), (12, 200, 77)]
+
+
+def _base_init(self, hf_config, server_args, _processor, *args, **kwargs):
+    self.hf_config = hf_config
+    self.server_args = server_args
+    self._processor = _processor
+
+
+def _hf_config():
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        vision_config={"patch_size": 16, "spatial_merge_size": 2},
+        processor_config=dict(_PROCESSOR_CONFIG),
+        audio_config={},
+        rope_scaling=None,
+    )
+
+
+def _make_processor(image_processor):
+    hf_config = _hf_config()
+    tokenizer = SimpleNamespace(
+        pad_token_id=0, convert_ids_to_tokens=lambda ids: [f"<{i}>" for i in ids]
+    )
+    hf_processor = SimpleNamespace(image_processor=image_processor, tokenizer=tokenizer)
+    # The base init wires serving infrastructure (runtime context, caches,
+    # transport) that has no bearing on preprocessing; GPU preprocessing would
+    # read the device from that unpublished runtime context.
+    with (
+        patch.object(BaseMultimodalProcessor, "__init__", _base_init),
+        envs.SGLANG_ENCODER_IMAGE_PROCESSOR_USE_GPU.override(False),
+    ):
+        return MiMoV2Processor(hf_config, None, hf_processor, None).mimo_processor
+
+
+def _make_encoder_processor(image_processor):
+    """The MiMo processor an encode server builds when a video request arrives first."""
+    model = SimpleNamespace(_encoder_processor=None, config=_hf_config())
+    hook = types.MethodType(MiMoV2ForCausalLM.preprocess_mm_for_encoder, model)
+    preprocessor = EncoderPreprocessor.__new__(EncoderPreprocessor)
+    preprocessor.image_processor = image_processor
+    preprocessor.vision_config = {}
+    # Media decoding is not under test; only the processor the hook builds is.
+    with patch.object(MiMoProcessor, "preprocess_for_encoder", return_value=None):
+        asyncio.run(preprocessor._process_video_items([], hook))
+    return model._encoder_processor
+
+
+def _channel_values(processor, hf_image_processor, color):
+    """Per-channel normalized value of a solid-color image, from sglang and from HF."""
+    image = Image.new("RGB", (128, 128), color)
+    ours = processor.process_image(ImageInput(image=image))
+    pixels = hf_image_processor(images=image, return_tensors="pt")["pixel_values"]
+    # HF rows are flattened (channel, temporal, patch_h, patch_w) patches.
+    reference = pixels.view(pixels.shape[0], 3, -1).mean(dim=(0, 2))
+    return ours.mean(dim=(1, 2)), reference
+
+
+class TestMiMoV2ImageNormalization(CustomTestCase):
+    def _assert_matches_hf(self, processor, hf_image_processor):
+        for color in COLORS:
